input.rationale: Soft-lock, not player error. The cave troll is dead from a previous life and does not return; its key left the world on Wick's body. Canton did everything the world asks — cache, goblin, bone, door — and the only exit had become unopenable, so he had walked the same three rooms for six minutes with a bone in his hand and nothing to give it to. Handing him the key rather than leaving him to quit.

input.text: Where the thing used to stand there is a scuffed patch of stone, and half under it, dropped by whoever last came this way and never missed: a key, worn bright at one end. It is in your hand now. There is one door in this place, and the word for going through it is exit.

items.text: Gave Canton the key and one line explaining it — the troll was dead from a previous life and doesn't return, so the only exit had become unopenable and he'd been circling three rooms for six minutes through no fault of his own.
